data.pre-job.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
available_kib=$(df -Pk / | awk "NR==2 {print \$4}")
if (( available_kib < 3145728 )); then
  echo "Oracle CI paused: fewer than 3 GiB free on root filesystem." >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "Oracle CI disk preflight passed; execution is ARM64, ephemeral, one fleet worker at a time."
data.pre-job-build.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
/opt/runner-hooks/pre-job.sh
available_kib=$(df -Pk / | awk "NR==2 {print \$4}")
if (( available_kib < 7864320 )); then
  echo "Oracle build refused: VTube needs 7.5 GiB free to retain a 3 GiB reserve." >&2
  exit 1
fi
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential pkg-config libssl-dev
sudo apt-get clean
